values.description: Production API URL. Switch to http://localhost:5000/api/v1 for local development.
JWT access token (15-min expiry). Auto-populated by Login and Verify Email test scripts.
Opaque refresh token (7-day expiry). Auto-populated by Login and Verify Email test scripts.
Authenticated user's ID (CUID). Auto-populated by Login and Verify Email test scripts.
Shipment CUID. Auto-populated by Create Shipment test script.
Shipment tracking number (format: LF-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXXXX). Auto-populated by Create Shipment.
Payment record CUID. Auto-populated by Initiate bKash / Stripe Checkout test scripts.
Hub CUID (origin hub). Auto-populated by Create Hub test script.
Destination hub CUID for transfers. Set manually after creating a second hub.
Hub transfer CUID. Auto-populated by Create Hub Transfer test script.
Zone CUID. Auto-populated by Create Zone test script.
Pricing rule CUID. Auto-populated by Create Pricing Rule test script.
Courier assignment CUID. Auto-populated by Assign Courier test script.
Courier profile CUID (not the user ID — the courierProfile.id). Set manually after creating a courier user.
Notification CUID. Auto-populated by Get My Notifications test script.
